title: Camera Scan Action Schema
description: CameraScanAction parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.action.schema.json.

wait_nodes.title: Wait Nodes
wait_nodes.description: Recognition nodes checked before scanning and after every camera movement; success if any hits.

aim_target.title: Aim Target
aim_target.description: After a recognition hits, move its result box center to the screen center before returning success. Defaults to false.

yaw_step_px.title: Yaw Step Pixels
yaw_step_px.description: Horizontal swipe distance for one camera step. Defaults to 240.

pitch_step_px.title: Pitch Step Pixels
pitch_step_px.description: Vertical swipe distance for one camera step. Defaults to 120.

fallback_yaw_steps.title: Fallback Yaw Steps
fallback_yaw_steps.description: Discrete horizontal movements in each fallback ring. Defaults to 12.
